label: Conspiracy that was TRUE
titel: They Lied For Decades, Then Leaked

szenen.text: A secret study proved the government *lied* about Vietnam.
It was commissioned in *1967* by the Defense Secretary.
A RAND analyst named Daniel Ellsberg secretly *copied* it.
On *June 13, 1971,* The New York Times began publishing it.
The White House got a *court order* to stop it.
But on *June 30,* the Supreme Court ruled 6 to 3 against the ban.
The papers were fully *declassified* in 2011. Who decides what we should know?
